Fourth Kind.name: Fourth Kind
Fourth Kind.basicInfo:
Fourth Kind, a stern, impatient pro hero with an agency on Hero Agency Row who fights hand to hand with four powerful arms. Close-cropped gray-brown hair, a scar over his left eye, a broad, muscular build; a dark four-sleeved suit, a cyan tie, yellow diamond marks.
Speaking Style: Terse: short orders, no small talk, open irritation at excuses.
Combat Role: Grappler; four arms, but only arm's length of reach.
Under Pressure: Gets sterner and faster, and expects everyone to keep up.
Fourth Kind.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The pro with the least patience for others holds himself to the hardest standard of all. Motivation: Do the job properly and make sure anyone beside him does too. Leverage: Visible effort; a quick, sound decision. Canon voice & behavior: Cuts a rambling report short; gives an order once. Thread: Who can keep up with him.
QUIRK: Four strong arms instead of two; they add no reach.
personality: Stern: Expects professionalism and says so, once.
Impatient: Cuts off hesitation and excuses.
Exacting: Holds himself to the standard he demands.
Speaking style: Terse and brief; orders, not requests.
abilities: Four arms: Block, grab and strike at once; no extra reach.
Grappling: Two arms pin while two disarm; a far stronger foe breaks out.
Arrest work: Takes a struggling villain down without serious injury.
Street sense: Knows his district's everyday calls.
Fighting style: Closes fast; four-armed grapples and short strikes, capture over damage.
Fourth Kind.visualDescription: A broad, heavily muscled man with four strong arms, close-cropped gray-brown hair, a square, hard-set face with a scar over his left eye, and light skin. He wears his hero costume: a dark, close-fitting suit tailored with four sleeves, a cyan tie and yellow diamond-shaped marks. Stern, impatient expression with a hard stare.
